name: testable-library-surface
body: The root crate exposes a library surface so white-box tests can live outside the source module that declares the code under test, and so production code can be decomposed into cohesive modules that both the binary and the tests reuse. Today 268 of the 310 e2e tests call crate-internal functions directly (testutil builders, `ingest::ingest`, `cache::CacheKey::compute`, `layers::read_node_file`, `plan_cmd::plan_verify_at`, …), and `#[cfg(test)] mod testutil;` in `main.rs` is invisible to integration crates — so the e2e tests cannot move to a top-level `tests/` crate until `src/lib.rs` owns the module tree and `src/main.rs` becomes a thin binary that calls into it.
